Built a complete playable browser game in `index.html`.

### Included
- Retro 90s arcade presentation with CRT scanlines, pixel typography, neon palette, and dramatic title screen
- Pseudo-3D perspective arena with grid floor, lighting, crowd accents, and fighter sprites
- Character selection screen with four fictional celebrity-style fighters
- Player vs CPU combat
- Controls:
  - Arrow keys / on-screen arrows: move
  - `Z` / A button: quick hit
  - `X` / B button: star power attack
  - `C`: guard
- Health bars, round HUD, pause/resume, hit sparks, attack effects, win/loss screen
- Responsive desktop and phone/tablet layout
- Touch controls for mobile
- Tested with browser automation and generated JPEG screenshots for desktop and gameplay verification

Assumption: I used fictionalized celebrity-inspired characters rather than real individuals, while keeping the modern celebrity-fighting-show tone.
